nodes.name: App.jsx
nodes.summary: Top-level application shell. The App component gates on authentication and renders either Login or ChatApp; ChatApp is the full chat UI that manages sessions, messages, tool steps, health polling, and SSE streaming consumption.
nodes.languageNotes: Single 250-line ChatApp component using many useState/useEffect hooks to orchestrate sessions, streaming, and tool-step rendering rather than splitting into smaller components.

nodes.name: Login.jsx
nodes.summary: Login and registration page component with a username/password form, mode toggle between login and register, loading/error states, and delegation to the api.js auth helpers.

nodes.name: api.js
nodes.summary: HTTP and SSE client layer for the FastAPI backend. Manages JWT auth tokens in localStorage and exposes fetch wrappers for every backend endpoint (auth, chat, sessions, history, tools, health), including a manual ReadableStream-based SSE parser for streaming chat.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses fetch + ReadableStream.getReader() + TextDecoder for SSE parsing instead of EventSource, allowing POST requests with Authorization headers for streaming chat.

nodes.name: main.jsx
nodes.summary: React entry point that mounts the App component into the #root DOM node via ReactDOM.createRoot.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Top-level auth-gate component that checks login state and conditionally renders the Login screen or the ChatApp workspace, wiring logout to clearAuth.

nodes.name: ChatApp
nodes.summary: Main chat workspace component. Manages thread/session list, message state, tool-step rendering, connection health, and the full send loop that consumes the SSE stream from streamChat and progressively updates the assistant message.

nodes.name: Login
nodes.summary: Login/register form component with mode toggle, input validation, loading and error states, and submission that calls the api.js login or register helpers and propagates auth success via onAuthed.

nodes.name: authRequest
nodes.summary: Central authenticated POST helper used by login and register. Sends a JSON body with the Bearer token, normalizes error messages, and persists returned auth credentials on success.

nodes.name: streamChat
nodes.summary: Opens a streaming POST to /api/chat and reads the SSE response body via a ReadableStream reader, buffering text, splitting on block boundaries, parsing each block via parseSSEBlock, and forwarding structured events to the onEvent callback. Clears auth and throws on 401.

nodes.name: parseSSEBlock
nodes.summary: Parses a single SSE event block by walking its field lines, collecting data: lines, and JSON-parsing the concatenated data payload into a structured {type, data} event object.

nodes.name: chat
nodes.summary: Non-streaming POST to /api/chat returning the assistant response JSON; clears local auth on 401 Unauthorized.

nodes.name: getHistory
nodes.summary: Fetches a thread's message history from /api/history and reconstructs it into ordered user/assistant message objects suitable for direct rendering in the chat view.
